authorization: Researcher authorization for correcting and evaluating simulated-data methods through execution of this prompt.
selection_basis: Exploratory corrected pilot selected S1 and S5 because they represent the continuous stable regime and the rounded/tied nonzero-MAD regime central to the reference-uncertainty question; this is not a prospective preregistration of the whole project.
primary_questions: S1/MAD RMS centered-shape displacement: P2 versus P3 interval coverage and width, separately by interval family.
S5/MAD: P2 versus P3 interval availability, conditional coverage, and available-and-covered probability over all attempted outer datasets, separately by interval family.
secondary_policy: All other comparisons are secondary or diagnostic; no superiority claim from conditional coverage when availability differs.

truth_policy.S6: not confirmatory; corrected pilot diagnostic only
truth_policy.S5_mean_level_change: exactly zero by identical rounded marginal symmetry
